title: Lumen Strike: I made a free bullet-hell sky shooter you can play in your browser.
author: Substantial-Sport573

comments.author: Substantial-Sport573
comments.body:
https://reddit.com/link/pcpagu9/video/stptc2gw4dsh1/player

Here's a quick trailer so you can see it in motion 

It's a free vertical shooter that runs in the browser (desktop + mobile). You pick one of five ships, and it slowly turns into Touhou-style bullet hell as you go through the worlds, with bosses that change form mid-fight.

Any feedback is welcome, especially on difficulty and how it feels on mobile!
